name: pigment64
notes: Prebuilt Apple Silicon binary from the upstream GitHub release 0.6.3 (asset pigment64-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz; sha256 is of that archive). Mach-O arm64; `pigment64 --version` reports 0.6.3. Upstream MIT licence. test.sh makes a 4x2 RGBA PNG with pure Python, converts it to N64 RGBA16 and checks the exact bytes, converts back to PNG and to bin again (round trip), and checks an I8 output size. Passed on 2026-10-16 with this binary.
